records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the three months ended June 30, 2023, 60% of our consumption-based revenues were derived from fees paid for data ingest and 40% were derived from fees paid for provisioned users.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Subscription revenue decreased $34.4 million, or 54%, while consumption revenue increased $60.5 million, or 39%, in the three months ended June 30, 2023, compared to the same period of 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We had remaining performance obligations of $738.9 million as of June 30, 2023, consisting of both billed and unbilled consideration.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our gross margin for the three months ended June 30, 2023 and 2022 was 78% and 71%, respectively, primarily driven by the transition of our platform from local data centers to public cloud hosting providers.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: During the three months ended June 30, 2023, cash provided by operating activities was $78.3 million, which was an increase of $35.3 million compared to the same period of 2022.
